claims.statement: The dated same-volume census retains5661 parent candidates/10108187384 bytes, excludes nine nested repositories and inspects three Rust log/bin locations separately. Fresh census/lstat checks agree; aggregate inflation and balanced wrong sizes reject; zero removals.
claims.scope: Exact October3 dated metadata snapshot and current direct OS metadata verification. Parent walk excludes caches/managed runs/generated book/Dart/Rust target, with explicit Rust release/incremental/deps probes. Other repositories/submodules, symlinks and other volumes excluded. No content-hash ownership, disposability, runtime, resource reclamation or liveness/purge guarantee.

rederive.granularity: Each retained path/suffix/byte-size row, nested/symlink/volume exclusion and explicit Rust row. Complete snapshot to fresh census and independent lstat; controls at per-file/aggregate granularity. Captures emit stdout only; default reviewer reads stored totals without live recensus.
rederive.result: Actual source-bound snapshot retained, fresh census and independent per-file metadata match. Two observed corruption rejections and included/excluded fixture pass. Rendered retention teaching passes. Zero deletion operations; fullCI not required for this maintenance record.

falsify.hypothesis: Aggregate counts can hide missing artifacts, balanced wrong file sizes, or traversal into another repository/symlink/volume.
falsify.oracle: Per-path independent lstat, a fresh scoped census and explicit inclusion/exclusion fixture with a nested Git marker, plus retained scope exclusions.
falsify.red_control: Inflated aggregate count rejects. Balanced +1/-1 log sizes keep all bucket totals green but reject against actual per-file lstat. Fixture retains only two artifacts/Finder metadata and excludes ordinary files, .git/.agents, mock submodule and nested Git directory. These are census data controls, not runtime semantic mutants.
